title: subject
description: The entity occupying the first coordinate of a predication cell (s, p, o), denoted s - the entity of which the predicate is asserted. Generated as one coordinate of the entity-pair index E x E over which predication-cell fiber algebras are built.

entity.description: an element of the entity set E; the thing that fills the slot

coordinate.description: the first coordinate of the cell (s, p, o), s in E x E

role.const: the entity of which the predicate p is being asserted
role.description: v(p)(s, o) records the epistemic state on 'p holds of s in relation to o'
